en.why: A familiar macOS Dock motion says "an app was installed" with no text needed. The radiating short lines appear only once and are very small, which marks the landing point without taking over the frame.
spec: Timing

Gap opens and icon grows 0.45–0.95s (0.5s, 15 frames); radiating strokes 0.95–1.30s (0.29s each, staggered 0.02s, about 9 frames); cursor appears 1.5s and moves 1.5–2.1s (0.6s, 18 frames); tooltip 2.2s; press dim 2.4s (0.1s, 3 frames); window opens at 2.5s over 0.55s; typing 3.45–4.84s; checkbox click 5.8s; window closes 7.4s (0.42s); icon lands 7.8s, wordmark unfolds 8.4s (1.2s); film 11s
Easing

Growth cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) (back.out(1.4)); cursor cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1) (power3.inOut); window open cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) (expo.out); strokes draw power2.out and retract power2.in; window close power3.in; wordmark expo.out
Camera
Dock magnified 3.0x on a fixed point, pushing slowly to 3.06x until 2.5s; at the click, cut to a medium shot (1.0x, drifting to 1.012x) where the window opens from a small size at the center
Subject

A 13-slot macOS Dock (12 icons and a separator); the new icon's slot grows width 0→64px (gap 0→8px) while its icon goes scale 0.6→1 and fades in, and neighbors slide apart as the Dock re-centers; after it settles, four 2.1px strokes (at −96°, −62°, −30°, 2°) flick out of its upper right corner; the Dock magnifies icons 1.58x near the cursor; the opened window is a notes app with a checklist
Sync

The icon dims (opacity 0→0.32) on the press frame at 2.4s and the window opens 0.1s later at 2.5s; in the window a checklist row types a new item at 0.042s per character, and the click at 5.8s checks the box, updates the counter to "3 of 5" and the progress bar to 60% on one frame
Style

Light gray-white #efeff2 base with a soft orange, pink, and blue gradient wallpaper; frosted Dock plate (backdrop-filter: blur(24px)); gradient squircle icons; the end card is a large icon plus a wordmark and one-line tagline
en.prompt: Show your app being installed with a shot called Dock Arrival. The frame is a macOS Dock magnified 3x on a fixed point with a very slow push to 3.06x. Starting at 0.45s, open a gap between two icons over 0.5s and grow your app icon in it (width 0 to 64px, gap 0 to 8px, scale 0.6 to 1, back.out(1.4)). After it settles, flick four 2.1px strokes out of its upper right corner, each drawing in 0.13s and retracting by 0.29s, staggered 0.02s. At 1.5s the cursor enters and moves to the icon over 0.6s with power3.inOut, the Dock magnifies icons 1.58x near it, and a tooltip appears. At 2.4s the icon dims over 0.1s, and at 2.5s cut to a medium shot where a notes window scales from 0.16 to 1 over 0.55s with expo.out. Type a new checklist item at 0.042s per character, click its checkbox at 5.8s and change the checkbox, counter and progress bar on the same frame. At 7.4s fold the window back to the center over 0.42s with power3.in, land a large icon with back.out(1.5), then slide it left while the wordmark unfolds with clip-path and blur 10px to 0 over 1.2s with expo.out.
says: A new icon shows up in the Dock
The icon grows in with a little spark
Click the icon to open a window
vs: Morph Relay is one element changing shape continuously; Dock Arrival adds a new element to the Dock and then opens a window on click.
Pile-up and Clear piles up more and more elements and then clears them; Dock Arrival adds only one element.

缓动
长出 cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)（back.out(1.4)）；光标 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)（power3.inOut）；开窗 cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)（expo.out）；短线绘出 power2.out、收回 power2.in；关窗 power3.in；字标 expo.out
镜头
Dock 放大 3.0x 锁定在一个点上，到 2.5s 缓推到 3.06x；点击后切到中景（1.0x，缓推到 1.012x），窗口从中心小尺寸放大打开
主体
13 个槽位（12 个图标加一条分隔线）的 macOS Dock；新图标所在槽位 width 0→64px（间距 0→8px），图标 scale 0.6→1 并淡入，Dock 重新居中使相邻图标向两侧滑开；落定后图标右上角弹出四条 2.1px 短线（角度 −96°、−62°、−30°、2°）；光标靠近时 Dock 图标放大 1.58x；打开的窗口是带清单的笔记 App
同步
光标按下的 2.4s 那一帧图标变暗（透明度 0→0.32），0.1s 后 2.5s 开窗；窗口里清单新行以每字符 0.042s 打字，5.8s 点击让复选框打勾、计数变成「3 of 5」、进度条变成 60%，三者同一帧
风格
浅灰白 #efeff2 底，橙、粉、蓝柔和渐变壁纸；磨砂 Dock 底板（backdrop-filter: blur(24px)）；渐变圆角方形图标；尾卡是大图标加字标和一行标语

en.title: Dock Arrival: macOS Dock Animation Recipe
en.description: A new icon grows into a magnified macOS Dock with one small spark, and a click opens a window. Make it with Claude Code or Codex from the free recipe.
en.lede: A magnified Dock opens a gap, a new icon grows into it with one small spark, and a cursor click opens the window.
en.name: Dock Arrival

body.h2: How to make a Dock Arrival with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Start with a 13-slot Dock magnified 3.0x on a fixed point, pushing slowly to 3.06x. At 0.45 s the new icon's slot grows from 0 to 64 px wide while the icon scales from 0.6 to 1 with back.out(1.4) over 0.5 s, and its neighbors slide apart as the Dock re-centers. At 0.95 s four 2.1 px strokes flick out of the icon's upper right corner.

Bring in the cursor at 1.5 s with a 0.6 s power3.inOut move. Dim the icon on the press frame at 2.4 s, then open the window at 2.5 s with expo.out over 0.55 s while the shot cuts to a 1.0x medium view. The dim, the click and the window opening sit on adjacent frames, so the three read as one gesture.

Press the copy button on the recipe page and paste it into Claude Code or Codex, or run npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent renders an 11-second MP4 with HyperFrames, or ports the GSAP timeline to your website with your own app icon and window content.

en.alt: A notes app window open on a Mac desktop with the dock below and the cursor near a checklist.
faq: What is a Dock arrival animation?

It is a motion pattern where a new app icon appears in a macOS-style Dock. The existing icons slide apart, the new icon grows into the gap, and a short flourish marks where it landed. It tells the viewer an app was installed or became available without any text.
Can I build a Dock animation on a website?

Yes. The Dock is a row of HTML elements whose width and scale are animated with GSAP, on a plate with backdrop-filter: blur(24px). In this recipe icons magnify 1.58x near the cursor, and the same timeline runs on a page or in a rendered video.
Is the Dock Arrival recipe free to use?

Yes. Motionboard is free and MIT licensed, so you can use and modify the recipes and the films they produce in personal and commercial projects. The licence asks only that copies of the recipe files keep the copyright notice.

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做Dock 图标动画
body.body:
先做一个 13 格、放大 3.0 倍的 Dock，镜头定点缓推到 3.06 倍。0.45 秒起，新图标所在格的宽度从 0 长到 64px，图标缩放从 0.6 到 1，缓动用 back.out(1.4)，历时 0.5 秒，相邻图标随 Dock 重新居中而滑开。0.95 秒时，四条 2.1px 的短线从图标右上角弹出。

光标 1.5 秒出现，用 power3.inOut 移动 0.6 秒。2.4 秒的按下帧让图标变暗，2.5 秒窗口用 expo.out 在 0.55 秒内打开，镜头同时切到 1.0 倍中景。变暗、点击和开窗放在相邻帧上，观众会把它们看成同一个动作。

在配方页点复制按钮，粘贴给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以运行 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装技能。智能体会用 HyperFrames 渲染 11 秒的 MP4，或者把 GSAP 时间线移植到你的网站，图标和窗口内容换成你自己的产品。

zh.alt: Mac 桌面上打开的笔记应用窗口，下方是程序坞，鼠标停在待办清单旁。
faq: Dock 图标出现动画是什么？
指在 macOS 风格的 Dock 里出现一个新应用图标的动效：原有图标向两侧滑开，新图标长进空位，再用一个很短的小动作标出落点。不用文字，观众就能看出应用已经安装或可以使用。
能在网站上做 Dock 动画吗？
可以。Dock 是一排 HTML 元素，用 GSAP 动画控制宽度和缩放，底板用 backdrop-filter: blur(24px) 做磨砂。配方里光标附近的图标放大 1.58 倍，同一条时间线既能放在网页里，也能渲染成视频。
Dock 图标动画配方可以免费使用吗？
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
